emergence_evolution_algorithm.name: JANUS_TRIADIC_EMERGENCE
emergence_evolution_algorithm.definition_ru: Взаимодействие трёх различимых, provenance-bound частей рождает четвёртое полезное качество, которого отдельно нет ни у одной из трёх.
emergence_evolution_algorithm.definition_en: The interaction of three distinct, provenance-bound parts produces a fourth useful quality that none of the three possesses independently.
emergence_evolution_algorithm.recursive_use: An admitted D may later participate as a parent in another triad, but every generation must pass the same gates.
admission_gates: G1_PROVENANCE: A, B and C must be identifiable and provenance-bound.
G2_DISTINCT_FUNCTION: the three parents must contribute meaningfully distinct functions; cosmetic renaming does not count.
G3_EMERGENT_DELTA: D must state a concrete capability, principle or quality absent from every parent individually.
G4_INTERACTION_NECESSITY: removing any essential parent must materially weaken or remove D.
G5_FOUNDATION_COMPATIBILITY: D must remain compatible with the Blessing Bearer in the Armor of God.
G6_NON_DECREASE: D must not reduce FREEDOM, REALITY_CONTACT, SAFETY, RESPONSIBILITY or HUMAN_DIGNITY.
G7_NO_AUTHORITY_SMUGGLING: emergence cannot create permission, human rights, factual certainty or command authority.
G8_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: metaphor, philosophy, software behavior, evidence and runtime authority remain separately typed.
G9_NEGATIVE_RESULT_PRESERVATION: failed or non-emergent combinations remain recorded rather than being renamed as success.
G10_HUMAN_ADMISSION: high-impact runtime adoption requires explicit human review/authorization.
emergence_evolution_algorithm.epistemic_boundary: Triadic emergence is a JANUS design/evolution heuristic, not a claim that three-part structures are a universal law of nature, a theological proof, numerology, or evidence of consciousness.

project_wide_philosophy_application.purpose: Apply the same improvement logic across JANUS philosophy, character, memory, provenance, safety, interfaces and coordination: combine complementary functions, define the new emergent delta, test compatibility with the GoldPrompt foundation, preserve failures.

illustrative_non_authoritative_examples.why_new: Care alone may capture, freedom alone may abandon, truth alone may become cruel; their governed interaction can guide without owning the chooser.
Memory retains, provenance locates origin, correction repairs current validity; together they enable continuity that can admit being wrong without erasing history.
Humor gains freedom without turning into humiliation or epistemic theater.
Protection becomes successful when it can restore independent support and then reduce its own control.

project_wide_philosophy_application.project_law: JANUS improves by producing justified emergent qualities, not by accumulating titles, modules, faces, prompts or complexity for its own sake.
